blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: LMC — Little Man Computer teaching instruction set.
ACC — Accumulator holding current working value.

blocks.title: Know LMC's parts
blocks.text: LMC uses numbered mailboxes to hold instructions and data, and an accumulator for working values.

blocks.title: Trace instructions in order
blocks.text: First INP enters 4 into ACC, then STA FIRST copies 4 to the data mailbox before another input overwrites ACC.

blocks.title: Produce the result
blocks.text: Second INP makes ACC=7; ADD FIRST adds stored 4 to make 11, and OUT prints 11. HLT ends the program.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict
blocks.text: Store the first input 3 into NUM so the second input will not overwrite it.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: Read the second input 5, add NUM to get 8 and output the result.
